testingFeedback: Five issues: WebGPU startup failure, title sizing, AI Hub readiness timing, a narrow-phone hint overflow, and sequential rather than simultaneous Family Hour.
Two were game-breaking: WebGPU startup and AI Hub readiness.
Real-browser interaction and AI Hub harness runs.
Static inspection without running the game.
engineFeedback: The compact scene lifecycle and built-in camera.
The balance physics, activities and UI.
Validating WebGPU behavior across browser engines.
Provide an explicit supported fallback for browsers without WebGPU.
promptFeedback: The emphasis on a playable, controller-first vertical slice.
The scope combines a large simulation, multiplayer and a standalone deliverable.
Balancing the breadth of activities with cross-browser verification.
Prioritize required features and define an explicit minimum for each.

aiHub.name: A Little Off Balance
aiHub.tagline: A very serious game about a very wobbly week.
aiHub.description: Balance, breathe, and bravely face a talking scale on a cozy island. Play a week of delightfully questionable fitness or challenge friends in a three-event medley.
aiHub.controls: Left stick / WASD: lean; R2 / Space: breathe; L1/R1 or F/J: step; Escape / Options: pause.
